profileName: Enterprise External Norm and Applicability Assessment

cases.input: Expression E2 is published with future partial commencement while E1 remains in force.
cases.expect: Both expressions remain citable; provision-level commencement determines efficacy and duties.

cases.input: Market A is conditional while Market B is outside material scope.
cases.expect: Both immutable peer assessments coexist with distinct market pins.

cases.input: A provision starts after a conditional event and grants a 24-month transition.
cases.expect: Deadline derives from the actual provision commencement event; prior and successor expressions remain resolvable.

cases.input: A URL is used as legal norm identity.
cases.expect: Reject: legal work/expression/provision and source evidence are required.

cases.input: An internal interpretation replaces official provision text.
cases.expect: Reject and retain separate attributable WM-KNW-012 evidence.

cases.input: An applies conclusion is reported as compliance.
cases.expect: Reject because compliance is a separate claim against a duty.

cases.input: Conflicting assessments are collapsed by majority vote.
cases.expect: Reject; both peers remain and only explicit named supersession can replace one.

cases.input: One date on NormVersion commences all provisions.
cases.expect: Reject; commencement is provision-scoped and may be conditional.

cases.input: An issued assessment changes its expression and market pins in place.
cases.expect: Reject; issue a peer assessment and explicit supersession when eligible.

cases.input: One authority supersedes another authority's assessment series.
cases.expect: Reject; differing accountable series remain peers.

cases.input: A boolean exempt flag has no beneficiary, authority, scope or interval.
cases.expect: Reject as semantically incomplete.

cases.input: Expiry of an exemption changes the norm expression.
cases.expect: Reject; exemption lifecycle changes without mutating the norm.

cases.input: Assessment stores an unversioned bare jurisdiction code.
cases.expect: Reject until a stable external key-as-of and competence context are supplied.

cases.input: An applicability assessment directly mints a duty.
cases.expect: Reject; duty identity belongs only to WM-XCT-029.

cases.input: Compliance status is written onto ApplicabilityAssessment.
cases.expect: Reject; compliance is a separate claim against an instantiated duty.

cases.input: A source-copy hash is treated as norm identity.
cases.expect: Reject; hash is evidence for a manifestation, not norm identity.

cases.input: A compliance deadline is calculated from publication despite conditional commencement.
cases.expect: Reject; use the actual legal event basis.

cases.input: A derogation has no enabling authority.
cases.expect: Reject as an unsupported scope change.

cases.input: Evidence is insufficient at facts-as-of.
cases.expect: Preserve an indeterminate issued conclusion with limitations and review date.

cases.input: Two peers conflict and a deciding authority is named.
cases.expect: Preserve both assessments and a separate resolution path; no silent merge.

cases.input: A prior expression is repealed after assessments were issued.
cases.expect: Prior expression and pinned assessments remain queryable and citable.

cases.input: A valid derogation changes scoped efficacy above a protected floor.
cases.expect: The non-derogable floor remains effective.

cases.input: Assessment is performed later than its facts-as-of snapshot.
cases.expect: Both times are retained and neither rewrites legal time axes.

cases.input: Territorial and subject-matter competences overlap at facts-as-of.
cases.expect: Assessment references the external hierarchy and lists both competence bases.
